zh_CN: 每日谜题 — 即将推出

keys: Your friend solves the puzzle to open it. No app needed.
en: Your friend solves the puzzle to open it. No app needed.
zh_CN: 朋友解开谜题才能打开。不需要安装任何东西。

keys: Complete every puzzle in a destination to earn its postcard.
en: Complete every puzzle in a destination to earn its postcard.
zh_CN: 解开一座城市的全部谜题，就能得到它的明信片。

keys: Complete a destination first — you need a postcard to send.
en: Complete a destination first — you need a postcard to send.
zh_CN: 先完成一座城市——你得先有一张明信片才能寄。

keys: Nothing yet. Solve a puzzle to start the journal.
en: Nothing yet. Solve a puzzle to start the journal.
zh_CN: 还没有内容。解开一道谜题，日志就开始了。

keys: Paste it into the postcard page.
en: Paste it into the postcard page.
zh_CN: 粘贴到明信片页面即可。

keys: Pencil on the grid and paper on the cards. Kept quiet on purpose. Music is separate and not in yet.
en: Pencil on the grid and paper on the cards. Kept quiet on purpose. Music is separate and not in yet.
zh_CN: 格子上的铅笔声，卡片上的纸声。刻意做得很轻。音乐是另一回事，暂时还没有。

keys: Not in the prototype yet: music, daily puzzle, Steam integration.
en: Not in the prototype yet: music, daily puzzle, Steam integration.
zh_CN: 尚未加入原型：音乐、每日谜题、Steam 接入。
